programs.title: The Extraordinary States of Procopius
programs.desc:
Marcin Prokop sets off overseas once again.According to the stereotype, the United States is a place of endless possibilities, where everyone can fulfill their dreams.In the new season of the program, the host will meet people who have found the recipe for success in life.In this way, he wants to find out whether there is a set of universal rules that guarantee happiness.He will visit, among others, the Skid Row district in Los Angeles, the NASA headquarters in Pasadena, the desert in Utah and a gold mine in Colorado.In each episode, viewers will discover new stories and places
Opened in 1894, Huntsville Prison is an institution where over 580 people lost their lives.Executions of convicts were carried out using an electric chair, which can now be seen as a museum exhibit.David Stacks, a former prison guard, will talk about working there and the emotions that accompany meetings with the most dangerous criminals in America.Jimi Willet, former prison warden and execution supervisor, will reveal whether he ever managed to get used to death.Marcin will also ask him about the impact his job has on his family life.

programs.title: Secrets of the wrecks of the Baltic Sea
programs.desc: Franken is a German mechanically driven tanker sunk near Hel by Soviet aviation during World War II - on April 8, 1945.The wreck hides a story of great passion and, at the same time, great tragedy.Diving on it is demanding because you have to go below 40 meters, so partial decompression is necessary.In addition to the entire list of victims that Franken had when it sank in 1945, three divers should be added - a Czech and two Poles.The team places a symbolic expression of memory of the dead underwater, a monument that rests on the surface of one of the most dangerous wreck diving facilities.

programs.title: Secrets of the wrecks of the Baltic Sea
programs.desc: The controversial destruction of a historic ship which, against the will of the inhabitants of Rostock, Germany, was sold for scrap.Georg Büchner - a luxury liner lost buoyancy while being towed to the shipyard in Klaipeda, Lithuania, and went to the bottom.Former passenger Freddy Korthoudet tells us what an exclusive passenger ship the Büchner, once called the Charlesville, was.Tomek Stachura, together with a team of divers and a German journalist and enthusiast of the history of this machine, Merlin Franke, are trying to determine the actual course of events on May 30, 2013.It helps, among others:Frederik Janssens, Belgian souvenir collector.Divers descend to the wreck, which sank relatively recently and has not yet been destroyed by the sea.

programs.title: Men, Women, Wild
programs.desc: Three couples, husband and wife, mother and father, and a boy and a girl, set off on an extreme expedition.For three weeks they try to survive in the most dangerous places on the planet.

programs.title: Marooned with Ed Stafford 2
programs.desc: Former British Army captain and experienced traveler Ed Stafford continues to overcome new challenges.He became known to viewers as a steadfast man who is able to cope with any extreme situation.So far, among others:he underwent a test of survival for 60 days on one of the uninhabited islands of Fiji, where he had no supplies of food, clothing or necessary equipment.Moreover, he walked the trail leading along the Amazon River, which earned him a place in history and the Guinness Book of Records.In the next series of the program "Ed Stafford Beyond Civilization", the traveler once again sets off to the most hostile corners of the world, including the Gobi Desert in Mongolia and the crocodile-infested Guatemalan jungle.

programs.title: Naked and Afraid XL 3
programs.desc: Thirteen experienced survival experts try to survive for 40 days in extreme conditions in the African Ga-Selati river basin.They will certainly face predators.
